summary: Owns byte-count statistics for data streams, including active-window and aggregate RTPStats protobuf conversion.
responsibilities: Track total bytes and active-window bytes.
Reset active-window counters after the configured duration.
Mark aggregate stats end time when stopped.
Convert active and aggregate byte counters to livekit RTPStats.

inner.summary: Duration used for the active stats window.

summary: Tracks aggregate and active-window byte counters for data stream RTP statistics.

inner.summary: Guards byte counters and time fields.
Creation time used for aggregate stats.
Stop time used for aggregate stats after Stop is called.
Unix nanosecond timestamp for the current active window start.
Bytes observed in the current active window.

summary: Constructs data stats with creation time and active-window start initialized to now.
Adds bytes to aggregate and active-window counters, resetting the window when it expires.
summary_step: 1. Locks stats state and adds the byte count to the aggregate total.
2. When active windowing is enabled and the supplied timestamp is outside the current window duration, resets window bytes and moves the window start.
3. Adds the byte count to the current active-window total.

summary: Builds RTPStats for the currently active byte window when the window is still valid.
summary_step: 1. Returns an empty RTPStats when active windowing is disabled.
2. Reads current window state under lock and rejects expired windows.
3. Converts window start, current time, duration, byte count, and bitrate into an RTPStats protobuf.

summary: Records the stop time used by aggregate stats.
Builds aggregate-only RTPStats from creation time through stop time or now.
summary_step: 1. Reads aggregate state under lock and uses the recorded end time when available.
2. Falls back to the current time when Stop has not been called.
3. Converts start time, end time, elapsed duration, total bytes, and aggregate bitrate into an RTPStats protobuf.
